letter: My dearest Fats, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai feels brighter because you’re by my side. As the gentle winter breeze whispers through the palm trees, I’m reminded how warm your love keeps me, even on the coolest evenings. I still smile at the way you laugh at my goofy jokes and how you call me “cutie” with that twinkle in your eye. Thank you for filling each day since that magical 23rd of February with endless joy, adventure, and the sweetest moments. I love you more than words can ever capture.
poem:
In desert dunes, our hearts entwine,  
Your smile, my sun, forever shines.  
Together we dance through sand and time,  
Love’s endless rhythm, yours and mine.
